---
title: Privacy and responsible information sharing
description: What this alpha website does—and the information that should stay out of a public repository.
---

This is a static public website. TSP has not added analytics, advertising trackers, registration forms, a mailing-list form, or a database. Search uses a generated index of public website pages. Optional social links take you to external services only when configured.

The site is intended for GitHub Pages hosting; GitHub and any external service you choose to visit have their own privacy practices. Hosting may involve technical request logs outside TSP’s control.

Please do not submit personal information, participant records, identifiable accounts about young people, credentials, or confidential research material through public repository issues. A public issue is not a confidential feedback channel.

Before collecting program or research information, TSP must establish appropriate consent, safeguarding, data access, retention, and review arrangements. This alpha does not collect that information.

Privacy concerns or suggested corrections can be raised through the currently available routes described on [Get Involved](get-involved.qmd), without including sensitive details.
